activities.title: Legal Awareness Camp
activities.summary: A resource person from Saket Court led a session explaining what legally constitutes domestic violence — covering physical, mental, emotional, sexual, and economic abuse. The session also addressed property rights for women and how differential treatment of sons and daughters within families itself represents a form of violence, encouraging participants to recognize and speak up against injustice.

activities.title: "Chuppi Todo" (Break the Silence) Campaign
activities.location: Mahila Panchayat Office, Sapera Basti, Gharoli, Delhi
activities.summary: A four-day campaign against domestic violence. Day 1: art and slogan-writing on domestic violence. Day 2: participants wrote and performed a feminist song and a short play. Day 3: participants wrote about how their lives changed since joining the Mahila Panchayat. Day 4: a community rally with 50 women, including a street play (nukkad natak) depicting gender discrimination and domestic violence, aimed at reaching women who hadn't yet connected with the Mahila Panchayat.

activities.title: Gender Sensitization Workshop
activities.location: Deepak Sweets Restaurant, Mayur Vihar Phase-3, Delhi
activities.summary: A workshop raising awareness on gender equality and social norms. Activities included an icebreaker introduction game, discussions on how the same work is valued differently based on gender, a comparison of the freedoms and restrictions placed on boys versus girls, and a session on workplace sexual harassment and related laws. The workshop included a short film screening and closed with group discussion and a Zumba session.

activities.title: Capacity Building Training for Mahila Panchayat Members
activities.summary: A training conducted in partnership with Action India to strengthen the dispute-resolution and counseling skills of Mahila Panchayat members. Members shared their personal journeys with the programme through an interactive activity, followed by structured training on case-handling processes, role-play exercises, and court procedures.

activities.title: 3rd Awareness Campaign — Gender Empowerment
activities.summary: A multi-day awareness campaign on gender empowerment and women's identity, exploring what it means to eliminate gender-based discrimination and build a respected place for women in society, starting from within the home.

activities.title: Legal Awareness Camp — POCSO Act
activities.location: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Bhawan Vikas Samiti, Delhi
activities.summary: A camp focused on building awareness of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act among women and adolescents, covering children's legal protections against sexual offences.

activities.title: Gender Sensitization Workshop
activities.location: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Bhawan Vikas Samiti, Delhi
activities.summary: A workshop raising awareness about gender equality and the social status of women, and the forms of discrimination women commonly face.

activities.title: POSH & Marital Rape Awareness Session
activities.summary: A legal advocate led a session on workplace sexual harassment (POSH) and marital rape, opening a candid discussion with participants about consent within marriage. The session encouraged women to have open conversations with their daughters about recognizing and speaking up against these issues.

activities.title: Stakeholders' Consultation Meeting Against Domestic Violence
activities.participants: Mahila Panchayat staff, school principals & teachers, ASHA workers, police representatives, Sakhi Centre, DLSA (Karkardooma Court), and the area MLA
activities.summary: A consultation meeting bringing together government, legal, education, and health stakeholders to strengthen the community response to domestic violence. The programme opened with a performance by a teenage participant highlighting the discrimination often shown between the birth of sons and daughters in society.

activities.title: Good Touch, Bad Touch Session
activities.location: Municipal Primary School, Harijan Basti, Gharoli Village, Delhi
activities.summary: A child safety session including a short documentary on recognizing good touch versus bad touch, followed by open discussion. Children learned to identify safe and unsafe situations, the importance of speaking up to a trusted adult, and that staying silent out of fear is never the right response.

activities.title: Gender Sensitization Workshop
activities.summary: A workshop led by a resource person on gender discrimination, equality, and the effects of unequal treatment in society, using interactive activities and discussion to make the concepts accessible and relatable.

activities.title: Exposure Visit
activities.summary: A recreational day trip organized for Mahila Panchayat members and adolescent girls, offering a rare break from daily household responsibilities. The day included a shared meal followed by group activities — singing, dance, acting, and light-hearted mimicry — with enthusiastic participation across all age groups. Participants described the outing as joyful and described feeling like they'd relived their childhood.
